message:
test(safety): the guard runtime test makes its files only in a new run folder of its own under REMOTE60_TEST_TMP -- never %TEMP% (test-injection-finding r9)

b8dcc93's e2e_guard_runtime_test made e2e_guard_runtime_{empty,quiet,writeonly}_<pid>.log with
CREATE_ALWAYS under GetTempPathW and deleted them there -- outside the repository, against the
deletion boundary. e2e_test_root.hpp: REMOTE60_TEST_TMP must be a plain folder directly under
D:/remote/remote/.claude/test-tmp with no link on its path, checked before anything is created; the
parent makes a NEW guard-runtime-<pid>-<tick>-<n> folder and hands it to its children
(REMOTE60_E2E_RUN_DIR), which re-check it and create no folder. Files are CREATE_NEW inside it and
deleted only there, by the code that made them; the folder is left. No valid root: refused
(exit 2) before anything is made. GetTempPathW is no longer imported (checked in the exe).

Not run (the verifier's hold on the runtime test); built, 0 warnings.
